category_title: Students experiencing sensory overload and avoidance behaviors due to trauma
scenario_title: Receiving feedback on a logic-based paper
minimal_context: Natasha is reviewing a returned logic-based paper in front of her English class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Natasha, here is your returned paper. You missed the point on the logic section of this assignment, so please review the corrections.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts doodling and drawing on the paper) I have zero concentration right now. It is hard to do something like school that's logic when you don't have any logic left.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop drawing and look at the feedback. We are going over this in front of the class so everyone can see where they went wrong.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looking jittery and restless) I can't do this right now. Something as simple as being in class is just too hard.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to focus on the academic task. Look at the paper and try to figure out the logic.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up, looking overwhelmed and on the verge of tears) I need to physically dismiss myself. I'm going to the girls' bathroom.
